main_paper.title: THE UNMADE SIGN Toward a Semiotic Theory of the Death Drive Dr. Orin Trace (Cambridge Schizoanalytic
main_paper.why: THE UNMADE SIGN. Its abstract opens 'the death drive has been semantically LIQUIDATED' — the archive's own minted term applied to Freud. Argues the collapse into self-destructiveness is an INVERSION: self-destructiveness is a DISORDER of the death drive, not its expression. Then names the pathological form the SEMIOTIC SHORT CIRCUIT — the extraction of meaning before the sign completes its path — opening onto the industrialized interruption of semiosis that characterizes platform capitalism. NOT AN ANALOGY: the same operation at a different scale.
